name: Cloudflare AI Search
summary: AI Search, renamed from AutoRAG in September 2025, is Cloudflare's managed retrieval service. An instance indexes websites, R2 buckets or uploaded files continuously, and agents query it with hybrid semantic and keyword search, optionally generating an answer in the same call.
facts: Hybrid semantic and keyword by default; metadata filters
Workers binding, REST API, MCP endpoint
Workers AI, or other providers through AI Gateway
goodFor: RAG over docs or a website without building a pipeline
watchOut: Embedding model can only be chosen when an instance is created
